subject: Service concession and VAT evidence for Courier Healthcare account
messages:
From: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@courierhealthcare.com>
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-02 08:14 GMT
Subject: Discrepancy on Oct invoice + VAT documentation request

Hi Naomi and Laura,

Hope you're well. We reviewed Redwood's October invoice (INV-CH-20261031) and noticed a repeated line item for the streaming endpoint that appears to have been billed twice across two usage buckets — total impact ~€18,700. Our AP team is requesting a credit or refund for the overcharged amount and EU VAT evidence so we can reconcile on our side.

Primary asks:
- Can Redwood issue a service concession/credit memo for the overbilled amount?
- If credit is issued, can it be accompanied by VAT supporting documentation so we can apply it to our VAT filing?
- We prefer a refund to the bank on file, but are open to applying the credit to the next invoice if processing time will be long.

I've attached our VAT registration cert for Courier Healthcare in case that helps.

Thanks — would appreciate a quick confirmation of next steps and ETA.

Best,
Aisha Patel
Head of Finance, Courier Healthcare
attachments: VAT_certificate_CourierHealth.pdf

From: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@courierhealthcare.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-03 09:22 GMT
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on Oct invoice + VAT documentation request

Aisha — thanks for the clear note and for sending the VAT cert. Apologies for the billing mistake; we traced it to a tagging issue in the streaming router that duplicated a subset of requests during 10/12–10/14.

Proposed remediation:
- Redwood will issue a credit memo for €18,700 (service concession) against INV-CH-20261031. Draft credit memo attached (Redwood_credit_memo_CH-1129.pdf).
- We can either: (a) apply the credit to your next invoice (fastest), or (b) issue a refund to bank details you confirm (takes ~7–10 business days after finance approval).
- We will include an explicit VAT line on the credit memo and provide a supplemental VAT evidence PDF for your records.

Action items for Courier Healthcare: please confirm preferred resolution (credit vs refund) and re-attach bank details if you want a refund. Once you confirm, I'll loop our accounting team to process.

Marcus — can you review the attached draft credit memo and confirm the journal ID we should use so batches can be queued? Laura — FYI for the billing tag fix — we pushed a patch and will verify no recurrence.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood_credit_memo_CH-1129.pdf

From: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@courierhealthcare.com>
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Cc: Courier Healthcare Finance <finance@courierhealthcare.com>
Date: 2026-11-04 11:07 GMT
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on Oct invoice + VAT documentation request

Hi Naomi — thanks for the quick response and for the draft memo. We prefer a refund to the bank this time (we're reconciling cash flow). Bank details below (sent securely to AP):

Bank: EuroTrust Bank
IBAN: DE44 5001 0517 5407 3249 00
BIC: ETDEDEFF
Beneficiary: Courier Healthcare Ltd.

VAT cert is attached again. Our AP will need the completed credit memo with VAT line to close the reconciliation.

Please confirm when this has been handed to finance and an expected date for funds.

Best regards,
Aisha
attachments: VAT_certificate_CourierHealth.pdf

From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-05 14:46 GMT
Subject: RE: Discrepancy on Oct invoice + VAT documentation request

Confirmed — I reviewed the draft credit memo CH-1129 and sign off on the amount and VAT handling. Marcus here from Finance: please process as a refund to the provided bank details.

Processing notes for accounting team:
- Journal: RJ-617 (see attached LedgerJournal_617.csv)
- Payment method: SEPA transfer, tag as goodwill/service concession (non-recurring)
- Expected payment window: 7 business days after payout batch (target payout date 2026-11-12)

Aditya — can you kick off the payout batch and confirm once the SEPA file is submitted?

Thanks — will notify Courier when the SEPA file is submitted and track settlement.

Marcus Lin
Senior Financial Controller
Redwood Inference
attachments: LedgerJournal_617.csv

From: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@courierhealthcare.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-09 16:38 GMT
Subject: Refund initiated — credit memo signature and settlement ETA

Aisha — quick update: Marcus approved and Aditya submitted the SEPA payout file this morning. Expected settlement date is 2026-11-12; we'll confirm when funds clear.

Next steps for paperwork:
- Please review and e-sign the final credit memo via this DocuSign link so our records show acceptance of the concession: https://docusign.com/tx/AX3B9-credit-memo-CH-1129
- Attached is the final credit memo with the VAT line included (Redwood_credit_memo_CH-1129.pdf).

If you'd rather have Redwood apply the credit to next invoice instead of refunding, reply and we'll cancel the payout. Otherwise we'll mark this closed once the SEPA settlement completes and you upload the signed credit memo.

Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. Laura — can you follow up on the tagging fix and confirm in the next week?

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood_credit_memo_CH-1129.pdf
